mapper.select: select count(*) from ( select n.AUTHOR_ID uid from dream_news n where n.TOPIC_ID = #{topicId} and n.AUTHOR_ID is not null and (n.DRAFT is null or n.DRAFT <> 1) and n.HIDDEN <> '1' union select c.USER_ID from dream_news_comment c join dream_news n2 on n2.NEWS_ID = c.NEWS_ID where n2.TOPIC_ID = #{topicId} and c.USER_ID is not null and (c.DELETED is null or c.DELETED <> '1') and (n2.DRAFT is null or n2.DRAFT <> 1) and n2.HIDDEN <> '1' ) t
